description: Sri Lanka Customs - Notify the Rates of Exchange effective from 01.10.2018 to 07.10.2018
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5) as it deals with statutory instruments and compliance requirements rather than government personnel, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
